2609.31468.title: PriceBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Price, Quality, and Brand Preferences in LLM Booking Agents
2609.31468.paper_summary: LLMs increasingly act as purchasing agents, which makes the LLM, not the user, the one choosing among the options that satisfy a request; its preferences quietly fix what gets bought and what it costs. Hotel booking is a clean instance: a high-volume choice settled on a few comparable attributes, where the pick reveals those preferences. We introduce PriceBench, a diagnostic benchmark that recovers an LLM's price, quality, and brand preferences from its booking choices with a logit choice model, applied to 28 LLMs from 8 providers on 3,600 hotel tasks from 179 real New York City properties. We find that capability is associated with how consistently an LLM chooses, not with what it chooses: more capable LLMs hold stronger, more consistent preferences, while weaker ones either lock onto one position, exploitable by whoever controls listing order, or choose almost indifferently. What those preferences favor varies sharply across providers and even within one family: price sensitivity spans more than an order of magnitude, and the price/quality trade-off moves mean booked nightly price from \$247 to \$393 on identical tasks. What an agent buys must therefore be measured per LLM, not inferred, and we release the tasks, code, and all 28 response sets.
2609.31468.paper_summary_zh: LLM 越來越多地充當購買代理，這使得 LLM 而非用戶成為在滿足請求的選項中進行選擇的主體；它的偏好靜靜地決定了購買的內容和價格。酒店預訂是一個清晰的例子：這是一個高頻選擇，基於幾個可比較的屬性，而選擇揭示了這些偏好。我們介紹了 PriceBench，一個診斷基準，通過邏輯選擇模型從其預訂選擇中恢復 LLM 的價格、質量和品牌偏好，該模型應用於來自 8 家提供商的 28 個 LLM，涵蓋來自 179 家真實紐約市酒店的 3,600 個任務。我們發現，能力與 LLM 的選擇一致性相關，而不是與其選擇的內容相關：更有能力的 LLM 擁有更強、更一致的偏好，而較弱的 LLM 要麼鎖定在一個位置，這一位置可以被控制列表順序的人利用，要麼幾乎無所謂地進行選擇。這些偏好的偏好在不同提供商之間以及同一家族內部變化劇烈：價格敏感度跨越了超過一個數量級，而價格/質量權衡使得在相同任務上的平均預訂夜間價格從 \$247 移動到 \$393。因此，代理購買的內容必須根據每個 LLM 進行測量，而不是推斷，我們釋放了任務、代碼和所有 28 組回應。
2609.31468.author: Pavel Kireyev et.al.
